In summary, we report that the final Immune Signatures Data Resource contains 53 cohorts from 30 studies with 1405 participants and 4795 samples.

method_quotes.quote: using the RMA algorithm 41 while the function read.ilmn ( limma R package) was used to read and background correct Illumina raw probe intensities. To integrate RNA-seq and microarray data, raw counts for RNA-seq data were transformed using the variance stabilizing transformation (VST).
Expression data within each study were quantile normalized and log-transformed separately for each cohort/sample type.

The target distribution was obtained from samples using Affymetrix platforms, resulting in a well-defined distribution, and each sample in our collection was quantile normalized to this target distribution.
